We were fooled and were sold a STALE cake. I would have brought it back but I had already eaten most of it as it was a small chunk. Today when I saw the reviews I saw that many people had a similar experience and hence decided to share my story as well.

So my dear people, DONT EVER BUY FROM CAKE OF THE DAY. THIS IS A GENUINE FIRST PERSON CUSTOMER REVIEW.
